name: Iharkutosuchus
sum: Small Late Cretaceous crocodyliform from Hungary, about 80 cm long, with a plant-grinding jaw.
wsnote: Skull up to 11.1 cm, body about 80 cm (Wikipedia).
material: Several partial skulls, isolated skull bones and numerous teeth are also known.
biology: Its mobile lower jaw could grind food, and wear on its teeth suggests a diet of fibrous plant material.
author: Osi et al. 2007
